Proxybase | Backend Systems Engineer (Rust) | Remote, Global | Full-Time
Hi HN,
I’m the founder of Proxybase [0]. We’re building a SOCKS5 proxy network focused on transparency and ethical sourcing in the residential proxy market.
A quick note for anyone who applied last month: thank you to everyone who reached out. We received far more strong applications than expected, and between running day-to-day operations and working through the backlog, we took much longer to reply than we should have.
If you applied last month and haven’t heard back yet, I’m sorry for the delay. We’re actively reviewing those applications alongside this new batch.
Why Proxybase?
The residential proxy industry has a rough history. Some providers rely on hidden background scrapers bundled into TV firmware or mobile apps, while others use payout systems that can hold provider funds for months.
We’re trying to build something better:
Open-source clients: Our GUI [1] and CLI [2] are fully open source, so anyone can inspect and audit what runs on their device.
Explicit consent: Providers knowingly opt in. No stealth bundling.
Fair, fast payouts: The minimum payout is $1, sent directly to provider wallets in USD stablecoins. We do not hold funds to earn interest on them.
We’re hiring a Backend Systems Engineer with Rust experience to help build:
Asynchronous SOCKS5 routing infrastructure,
Daemon and node orchestration,
Automated bandwidth-allocation pipelines
Stack: Rust, Tokio, Axum, SOCKS5, Linux systemd daemons, SQLite
Location: Fully remote, async-friendly, flexible time zones
Compensation: Competitive salary plus equity. USD or stablecoin payment options are available.
If you’re interested in building infrastructure for an industry that needs better standards, email jobs@proxybase.xyz with your GitHub, résumé, and a short note about what you’ve been working on recently.
I’ll also be around in the comments to answer questions and hear feedback.
[0]: https://proxybase.xyz
[1]: https://github.com/proxybasehq/proxybase-gui
[2]: https://github.com/proxybasehq/proxybase-cli

About PRGX
PRGX is the global leader in source-to-pay data analytics and software, and tech-enabled profit recovery services. We provide software and services to maximize revenue recovery and drive margin improvement for our clients. For more information about PRGX, visit www.prgx.com.

Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Product Analyst to join our Product Operations team at PRGX. As a vital member of the organization, you will contribute to data-driven decision-making processes and actively participate in the enhancement of our SaaS products. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical capabilities and is enthusiastic about leveraging data to contribute to product success.

Job Duties & Responsibilities
• Conduct analysis of product feedback and user behavior to identify opportunities for improvement; work hands-on with the software to gather insights and contribute to product direction.
• Prepare and deliver concise reports on user experience findings to cross-functional teams; present insights effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Collaborate on designing and executing tests to evaluate the impact of product changes; analyze test results to inform product development decisions.
• Work closely with product managers, engineers, and UX designers to understand product goals and objectives; provide analytical support throughout the product development lifecycle.
• Assist in maintaining governance best practices to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability in operational frameworks. PRGX | Confidential Recruitment Document PRGX Job Posting • Identify and promote best practices to enhance the effectiveness of the Product Operations team and contribute to product improvement.
• Manage projects, monitor progress, and identify opportunities to improve ways of working across the team.
• Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge & Qualifications
• Preferred bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or related experience.
• Proven experience, with 2+ years preferred, in product analytics, client success, business analyst, product owner, or a related role.
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies and understanding of the product lifecycle.
• Proficiency with Microsoft tools, including Outlook and Excel, with willingness to learn new tools.
• Detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize and organize workload to meet deadlines.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including excellent English communication skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
• Eagerness to learn and contribute to the success of the team.

2cbe356630a6a517.description:
India's largest banks, insurers, digital natives and government departments are not short of AI pilots. They are short of AI in production.
Closing that gap is the hardest problem in enterprise AI, and it is what Deployment Strategists at Sarvam do. You own the arc of a customer engagement, from the first proof of concept through to their systems running live, handling millions of real conversations across Indian languages and delivering the outcomes we signed up to. If Sarvam's technology is going to reach a billion people rather than sit in a slide deck, it happens through this team.
Every large institution is its own environment, with its own core systems, telephony, CRM, compliance perimeter and operational reality. You work out what it takes for an AI system to hold up inside that specific environment, run the programme, and stay accountable until it is live and performing.
Our engagements run from focused proofs of concept to multi-year programmes inside India's biggest enterprises and government departments, worth crores and reaching millions of people. We are hiring across levels to cover that range.
About Sarvam
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

What this role promises you
You own the outcome
You are not tracking someone else's plan. You own the scope, the timeline, and whether the numbers land. When a deployment works, it is because you made it work.
The room where AI meets the Indian economy
You will work directly with the leadership of India's largest banks, insurers and NBFCs, with central and state government departments, and with the fastest-moving companies in automotive, travel, healthcare, education and the digital-native economy. Different industries, different constraints, systems that go into live operation. Few roles in India offer this view of how AI actually reaches people.
What you'll do
• 
Own deployments end to end, from proof of concept through to the system running in production and hitting its committed KPIs.
• 
Run the proof of concept where a customer needs to see it work before committing at scale. Getting to a convincing result quickly is often what unlocks the full deployment.
• 
Do the implementation discovery a specific customer requires: their integrations, their processes, their data reality, their compliance constraints, their edge cases, and shape the solution around what you find.
• 
Run the programme: plan, timelines, dependencies, risks, scope discipline, and the difficult conversations when something is off track.
• 
Be the customer's point of contact through delivery.
• 
Work with the deployment team on your engagement, whether that is Sarvam's Agent Engineers, certified partner teams, or both, and hold the delivery quality bar for the engagement.
• 
Drive adoption on the ground. A system that works technically but is not used by the collections team, the branch staff or the citizen helpdesk has not landed. Getting it genuinely adopted is part of the job.
• 
Own the documentation and operating charter for your deployment: how the system is run, monitored and scaled after go-live, so it holds up long after the launch.
• 
Write the process and engagement playbooks that make the next deployment in that motion faster: how it gets scoped, planned, integrated and adopted.
Who you are
We are hiring across levels, from 4+ years of experience. What matters more than years is whether you have owned an outcome in front of a customer and delivered it.
• 
You have delivered, not just managed. You have owned client-facing delivery where the outcome was yours, whether that is a workstream inside a large programme or the whole programme itself. Most likely from consulting, high-quality systems integration, or an enterprise delivery organisation. You have carried a date and a number, not just a project plan.
• 
You are technical enough to be taken seriously. You do not need to write production code, but you should be able to argue with an engineer about an integration approach, understand why an evaluation is failing, and reason about latency, reliability and scale without hand-waving.
• 
You understand agentic AI. How LLMs and agents behave in production, why prompts and evaluations matter, and what breaks at scale. Ideally you have delivered AI systems yourself.
• 
You have worked inside hard environments. Large regulated enterprises, banks, insurers, or the public sector, where procurement is slow, integration is messy, and change management is most of the job.
• 
You communicate precisely. Crisp writing, clear escalation, no ambiguity about status.

Sarvam is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics. We believe the best AI for India can only be built by a team that reflects India.
